sections.title: Ki as the subject
sections.content: *Ki?* (“who?”) asks about the person who is going. The verb is always *megy*, the form for “he, she”, because the answer is somebody else: *Ki megy a moziba?* – *Anna megy a moziba.* The answer starts with the name. *Ki?* is for people; use *mi?* for things.

items.english: Who is going to the shop?
Károly is going to the shop.

sections.content: In *Hová megy Anna?* the question word asks about the place and Anna is known. In *Ki megy a kertbe?* the place is known and the question word asks about the person. Notice which part of the answer is new: it is the part that stands first.
